missions.title: Read the room
missions.label: FIELD INTELLIGENCE
missions.description: Read a short fictional case and choose the move supported by the evidence.

missions.title: Recover the evidence
missions.label: MEMORY DRILL
missions.description: Match six evidence pairs in 18 moves or fewer.

briefings.scene: A caller says the lobby is clear. The evacuation map marks a camera over the lobby desk. Which source gives you a confirmed detail?
A ledger is missing page 17. The torn edge in the binding matches a scrap on the desk. What should go into the evidence file?
A sealed envelope is labelled 02:14. A photograph shows the same room clock at 02:14. What does this establish?
choices: A matching recorded time, not a confirmed identity

briefings.scene: Two notes conflict. One names a street; the other names a person. What belongs in the case record?
choices: Both notes, with their sources and uncertainty

briefings.scene: A key fits a locked case, but the dial still needs four digits. Which next move follows the evidence?
The rear stairwell is marked on the map, but its door is locked. You have no matching key. What is confirmed?
choices: The route is ready to use
The door will open if ignored
The route exists, but access is unresolved

briefings.scene: A photograph contains a reflection of a second bag. No one has inspected that bag. What should the crew record?

reward.title: Your personal Crew ID wallpaper
reward.description: A personalized noir Crew ID for your phone. Download a 1080 × 1920 PNG after verification. Personal use only.
